concepts.definition: Total gross income the charity reports in its ACNC Annual Information Statement for its own financial reporting period, in Australian dollars. A period-specific monetary measure of the charity's income before expenses; the period qualifier is a bounded reporting interval with both a start and an end date, so a sub-annual period is distinguishable from a full year. It is not a business's taxable income or turnover and a blank or zero is not evidence of nil activity.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.financial.total_income is a business-owned total income fact for a business subject; this is a charity-role self-reported AIS figure with its own bounded reporting period, so reuse would change owner and reporting scope. ext.financial.taxable_income is a tax concept, not gross income.

concepts.definition: Total revenue the charity reports in its ACNC Annual Information Statement for its own financial reporting period, in Australian dollars, being the sum of its reported revenue components. A period-specific monetary measure whose period qualifier is a bounded interval (start and end date), distinct from total gross income, which also includes other income.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept holds a charity's reported total revenue; ext.financial.total_income is business-owned and does not distinguish revenue from other income, so reuse would change owner and meaning.

concepts.definition: Revenue the charity reports in its ACNC Annual Information Statement as received from government sources during its own financial reporting period, in Australian dollars, with the period qualifier being a bounded interval (start and end date). A revenue component, not a grant amount received by a business and not evidence of a government contract.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept covers charity government-sourced revenue; ext.financial.total_income is a business-owned aggregate and a contract/grant amount is not business income, so reuse would change owner, meaning and granularity.

concepts.definition: Revenue the charity reports in its ACNC Annual Information Statement from providing goods and services during its own financial reporting period, in Australian dollars, with the period qualifier being a bounded interval (start and end date). A revenue component, not total sales or turnover of a business.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept holds charity goods-and-services revenue; ext.financial.total_income is a business-owned aggregate, so reuse would change owner, meaning and granularity.

concepts.definition: Revenue the charity reports in its ACNC Annual Information Statement from investments during its own financial reporting period, in Australian dollars, with the period qualifier being a bounded interval (start and end date). A revenue component covering investment returns, not the value of the investments held.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept covers charity investment revenue; ext.financial.total_income is a business-owned aggregate and no shortlisted concept represents investment income for a charity role.

concepts.definition: Revenue the charity reports in its ACNC Annual Information Statement as donations and bequests received during its own financial reporting period, in Australian dollars, with the period qualifier being a bounded interval (start and end date). A revenue component, distinct from grants and donations the charity itself makes to others.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept holds charity donation and bequest revenue; the AIS also has separate outbound 'grants and donations made' columns with opposite direction, so a single reused concept would conflate inflow and outflow.

concepts.definition: Residual revenue the charity reports in its ACNC Annual Information Statement as all other revenue not captured by the named revenue components, for its own financial reporting period, in Australian dollars, with the period qualifier being a bounded interval (start and end date). A revenue component, not a catch-all for other income.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept covers residual charity revenue; ext.financial.total_income is a business-owned aggregate and dyn.charity.other_income (this patch) is a separate AIS line outside revenue, so reuse would change meaning.

concepts.definition: Other income the charity reports in its ACNC Annual Information Statement for its own financial reporting period, in Australian dollars, being income outside the reported revenue components, with the period qualifier being a bounded interval (start and end date). A period-specific monetary measure distinct from other revenue and from other comprehensive income.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept holds charity other income; ext.financial.total_income is a business-owned aggregate and dyn.charity.other_revenue (this patch) is a separate revenue line, so reuse would change meaning and granularity.

concepts.definition: Other comprehensive income the charity reports in its ACNC Annual Information Statement for its own financial reporting period, in Australian dollars, covering gains and losses recognised outside profit or loss, with the period qualifier being a bounded interval (start and end date). A period-specific monetary measure, not revenue and not other income.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept covers charity other comprehensive income; ext.financial.total_income is a business-owned aggregate and dyn.charity.other_income (this patch) is a different AIS line, so reuse would change meaning.

concepts.definition: Total comprehensive income the charity reports in its ACNC Annual Information Statement for its own financial reporting period, in Australian dollars, combining its surplus or deficit with other comprehensive income, with the period qualifier being a bounded interval (start and end date). A period-specific monetary measure that may be negative; it is not total gross income.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept holds charity total comprehensive income; ext.financial.total_income is a business-owned income aggregate and dyn.charity.total_gross_income (this patch) is a different AIS line, so reuse would change meaning.

reuse.ext.financial.total_income: Not reused for the charity income lines: owner is business and the AIS figures are charity-role self-reported amounts for the charity's own bounded reporting period, so owner and scope differ.
reuse.ext.financial.taxable_income: Not reused: a tax concept, not a charity's reported gross income or revenue line.
